description: This file defines the interface 'CustomerFacade', acting as a bridge between the CustomerService layer and web controllers, handling customer-related operations such as fetching data, registration, address management, and cart merging in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: A Java interface acting as a facade for customer-related operations, providing methods for retrieving, registering, updating, and managing customer data and sessions.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer details based on username and store information.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by their unique ID.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the shopping cart between session and customer data during login.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a username is already registered in a specific store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer with provided data.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address for a customer, either billing or shipping.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates the address details for a customer.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties for customer model based on store data.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using username and password.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Creates a customer model suitable for persistence from given data.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates customer entity with data from persistable customer, store, and language.
